name: SigNoz
tagline: OpenTelemetry-native APM and observability platform storing logs, metrics and traces in ClickHouse.
description: SigNoz is an open-source observability platform that combines APM, distributed tracing, log management, metrics and alerting in one product, built around OpenTelemetry from the start. Under the hood it uses ClickHouse as its storage and query engine, which gives fast aggregation over spans and logs and lets advanced users write ClickHouse SQL alongside the query builder and PromQL. It is a Datadog or New Relic alternative you can self-host with Docker or Helm, or use as SigNoz Cloud. Most of the code is MIT-licensed, while enterprise features such as SSO live in a separately licensed directory.

license.name: MIT (core) with separately licensed enterprise directory

pricing.notes: Community edition is free; SigNoz Cloud bills by ingested data; enterprise self-hosted is contract-priced.

scale.notes: Scales through the underlying ClickHouse cluster and OpenTelemetry collectors.

strengths: Logs, metrics and traces correlated in one UI
OpenTelemetry-native ingestion with no proprietary agents
ClickHouse storage gives fast aggregations over high-cardinality data
Self-hostable with Docker or Helm, plus a managed cloud
Permissive MIT licence for the core
weaknesses: You operate ClickHouse, ZooKeeper/Keeper and collectors when self-hosting
Some enterprise features (SSO, advanced RBAC) are commercial
Less mature than commercial APM suites for some integrations
useCases: Self-hosted Datadog or New Relic replacement
notIdealFor: Pure metrics at Prometheus-scale with PromQL-only tooling
